error[ZBX-E0322]: the container could not take a cgroup namespace
  while  starting container zbx-9bc203
  cause  taking a cgroup namespace of the container's own failed: operation not
         permitted (EPERM)
  cause  the kernel or a policy refused a cgroup namespace (unshare
         CLONE_NEWCGROUP), which kernels since 4.6 have
  name   zbx-9bc203
  rootfs /srv/alpine
  step   unshare_cgroup (10 of 71)
  fix    look for the policy that denies it:   sudo dmesg | grep -iE 'apparmor|seccomp|selinux|userns'
         check what this host allows:          zbx doctor
  more   zbx explain E0322
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0322.html
